assumption: The flagship is the canonical Court Brewhouse in visuals/LOCKED-SCENE-DNA.md: a limestone-and-glass Tank Hall at the west, a one-storey restaurant block on the north, three timber arcades and a shade court with an oak edge.
why_chosen: One coherent place keeps every image, plan and sentence describing the same building.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Site, building form and scale are all undecided.
visual_experience_effect: The whole world has one recognisable silhouette and a court you can walk into.
implementation_gate: Real site search, then an architect, then a code and zoning review.

assumption: A visible production brewery of six tanks plus a small brew deck, drawn as a working craft brewery, not as a volume plant.
why_chosen: Six tanks read as craft at a glance and fit the hall in the canonical geometry.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Brewery capacity, tank count and brewhouse size (G-6) are unresolved.
visual_experience_effect: Guests see real tanks at working scale.
implementation_gate: Brewery engineer and a licensed brewer decide capacity from demand and economics.

assumption: Stainless brewhouse vessels with a brushed finish. Copper is limited to a hood detail and small bar objects. No copper-clad vessels for show.
why_chosen: The founder rule: tanks are craft, not decoration. Fake copper would be decoration.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Brewhouse material and supplier are unselected.
visual_experience_effect: Calmer, more honest metalwork. Warmth comes from brass and amber light.
implementation_gate: Brewery equipment vendor quotes and professional design.

assumption: A removable orange (marigold-toned) sleeve around each fermenter, never paint on stainless. Marigold has ritual meaning in both traditions, so it stays on tanks and tap rings only until cultural reviewers decide.
why_chosen: Gives the hall a quiet signature and obeys the sanitary rule already recorded.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Tank finish and sleeve feasibility are unverified.
visual_experience_effect: One warm band repeats across the glass at night.
implementation_gate: Equipment vendor and food-safety reviewer.

assumption: Guests see brewing through glass from four places: lobby promenade, backbar window, court arcade and a mezzanine. No guest access to the production floor.
why_chosen: Shows the brewery without a safety compromise.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Safe guest viewing and fire and egress rules are unreviewed.
visual_experience_effect: Brewing is part of the evening, not a tour.
implementation_gate: Architect and code reviewer.

assumption: A long dark pecan bar with a restrained tap line of about eight handles: the five core beers, one rotating beer, and two zero-proof taps. Not a wall of taps.
why_chosen: NASHA is a food-and-beer system, not a taproom with food.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Beer range, tap count and NA-on-tap feasibility are open.
visual_experience_effect: The bar reads as curated and calm.
implementation_gate: Beer programme, draught-system design and licensing review.

assumption: Mixed service: table service in the dining room, bar ordering for solo guests, and a pass window to the court for casual food. No fast-casual counter.
why_chosen: Lets one room hold dates, families and solo guests.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Service model and labour approach are unresolved.
visual_experience_effect: The room feels hosted, not queued.
implementation_gate: Pilot learning, then operations design with professionals.

assumption: Roomy: dining tables and long communal tables are spaced for easy movement. Roughly one-third of seats are communal. No numbers are claimed.
why_chosen: Space and comfort photograph and feel better than packing.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Seat count, occupancy and economics are undecided.
visual_experience_effect: Light and shadow fall on people, not on rows of chairs.
implementation_gate: Architect, occupancy and code review, plus economics.

assumption: Dark pecan communal tables with a stainless inlay, two-tops and four-tops in the dining room, a bar counter and a few low seats at the court edge.
why_chosen: Variety gives each social condition a natural place.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Furniture and layout are undecided.
visual_experience_effect: The room serves a date, a family and a crowd differently.
implementation_gate: Interior designer and furniture sourcing.

assumption: Selective: the north arcade pass window and an enclosed oven mouth are visible; the line itself is not on display.
why_chosen: Heat and fire are felt without a theatre kitchen.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Kitchen layout, exhaust and fire separation are unreviewed.
visual_experience_effect: Guests see flame and plates, not a stage set.
implementation_gate: Kitchen designer and fire and health review.

assumption: A gravel shade court with a shallow stone rill, three arcades, cedar elms and a live-oak edge. No string lights.
why_chosen: Matches the canonical scene and Austin shade needs.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Site orientation, drainage and flood status are unknown.
visual_experience_effect: A cool, shaded place that works from day to night.
implementation_gate: Site survey, landscape architect and stormwater review.

assumption: Three core shapes instead of five: a tall Signature Hefe glass, a versatile Lager and Pils glass, and an Aromatic option for amber and witbier. A small flight tulip stays.
why_chosen: Three shapes are easier to remember, stock and photograph.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Glass count and manufacturability are unverified.
visual_experience_effect: The table looks tidy and recognisable.
implementation_gate: Glass vendor review, dishwasher and rack tests.

assumption: Beers arrive in a clean glass on a stoneware or wooden coaster; the Hefe is poured in two steps at the table side by a server only if it proves useful. No smoke, flame, dry ice or gimmicks.
why_chosen: A small ritual improves recognition without risk.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Service process is untested.
visual_experience_effect: A moment of care, not a show.
implementation_gate: Pilot service test and staff training.

assumption: Matte black stoneware with a raw outer rim, stainless katori for sauces, round steel trays with paper liners, indigo-and-bone napkins.
why_chosen: Consistent with the canonical scene and photographs naturally.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Tableware selection and durability are unknown.
visual_experience_effect: A table that looks the same wherever you sit.
implementation_gate: Tableware vendor samples and kitchen tests.

assumption: Charcoal canvas aprons and bone shirts for floor and bar; black work shirts for brewers; dark chef jackets for the kitchen.
why_chosen: Functional, warm and Austin-appropriate with no costume.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Uniform specification and supplier are undecided.
visual_experience_effect: Staff are recognisable without branding on the chest.
implementation_gate: Staff input, fabric tests, supplier sampling.

assumption: Signage is a system of materials and positions: a blank blackened-steel panel on a concrete plinth, a small blade sign, a door plaque. Text is a temporary placeholder.
why_chosen: The architecture must work if the name changes.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: The name is legally unresolved.
visual_experience_effect: The place is recognisable from its form before its sign.
implementation_gate: Name clearance, then signage design and city sign review.

assumption: A single pattern grammar: a perforation-and-weave system built from circles, steps and a square grid. No sacred or ceremonial motifs.
why_chosen: Structure over souvenir. It works on screens, tile and fabric.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Pattern adaptation and cultural review are open.
visual_experience_effect: A quiet texture shared by every surface.
implementation_gate: Cultural reviewers from both traditions.

assumption: A single folded card with five dishes first, beer beside them, an optional pairing line and a zero-proof list. No prices.
why_chosen: Quick to understand and optional pairing.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Menu breadth, pricing and layout are undecided.
visual_experience_effect: The menu reads in about a minute.
implementation_gate: Pilot learning, pricing work and a menu designer.

assumption: Each dish has one hero presentation (see the product document). These are designs, not cooked results.
why_chosen: Lets people see the intended product.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Recipes, plating and portion are untested.
visual_experience_effect: Appetite and clarity.
implementation_gate: Real cooks, tasting and costing in the pilot.

assumption: For the vision image, cauliflower is roasted and browned, not battered.
why_chosen: Lets the vegetable stay visible while the physical question remains open.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Roasted versus battered is still an R&D question.
visual_experience_effect: Cauliflower reads as cauliflower.
implementation_gate: Home test comparing both methods.

assumption: Goat birria, restrained: tacos with a small cup of consomme. Any Indian contribution stays invisible in the image.
why_chosen: Preserves identity and avoids social-media birria.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Whether any Indian element belongs is open.
visual_experience_effect: A dish that reads as birria first.
implementation_gate: Chef and cultural review, tested recipe.

assumption: Zero-proof drinks use the same glassware family in clear glass, with natural colour, one simple garnish and no children's-soda look.
why_chosen: They should look equally intentional beside beer.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: NA recipes are untested.
visual_experience_effect: Zero-proof sits at the table with the same dignity.
implementation_gate: Bar development and tasting.

assumption: Quiet-day to lively-night curve; no stereotyped playlist; live music is an open question.
why_chosen: Defines the room's energy without claiming licensing.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Acoustics, licensing and permits are unknown.
visual_experience_effect: The room can be talked in.
implementation_gate: Acoustic consultant, music licensing review.

assumption: Visions may show diverse adult guests, and families with children only in clearly separate non-alcohol moments (children never hold glasses from the beer-glass family), staff and brewers. None are identifiable real people.
why_chosen: The place should never look empty or exclusive.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Customer mix is unknown.
visual_experience_effect: Hospitality, not a set.
implementation_gate: Real customer observation in the pilot.

assumption: The vision scenario is one evening from 5:30 to late. It is a mood, not a prediction.
why_chosen: Communicates experience without inventing numbers.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Hours, covers and demand are unknown.
visual_experience_effect: A reader can imagine an evening.
implementation_gate: Pilot data.

assumption: Takeout, coaster, napkin and bag are concept drawings with placeholder text. No alcohol label is presented as compliant.
why_chosen: Shows a coherent system without regulatory claims.
blueprint_unknown_it_temporarily_resolve: Packaging rules and vendors are unknown.
visual_experience_effect: The brand continues outside the room.
implementation_gate: Regulatory and packaging review.
